name: Issue 3194: Ley Power stacks per nearby enemy and adds 10% per stack of damage dealt as Arcane damage
contract: Ley Power 801096: 'Divert ley energy into your weapons, drawing power from enemies within $a1 yds of you. For
each enemy in the radius, your damage dealt deals an additional $803258s1% of the damage as Arcane damage, up to
100%, for $801096d.' Radius index 9 (20 yd), duration index 8 (15 s). Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCRIPT_EFFECT on
TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY naming 802647, which force-casts Harvested Ley Energy 803258 on the caster: aura 354
(no core handler) of 9 + 1 = 10, StackAmount 10, naming 803282, the Arcane strike (SCHOOL_DAMAGE, CANT_CRIT,
SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 804316 ('Damage dealt now grants Harnessed Leylines') with ProcFlags 0 and no
spell_proc row. No script or SQL names 801096, 802647, 803258, 803282 or 804316, so casting grants no stacks,
adds no Arcane damage and grants no Harnessed Leylines. Expected: three enemies within 20 yd and one beyond it
give three stacks; the caster's melee damage then adds 30% of each hit as 803282 on the struck target, and

steps.label: SETUP: no Harnessed Leylines before Ley Power
Ley Power draws from the enemies around the caster
One Harvested Ley Energy stack per enemy within 20 yd
Harvested Ley Energy is worth 30% at three stacks
Each hit adds 30% of its damage as Arcane damage to the struck target
Damage dealt under Ley Power grants Harnessed Leylines
Harvested Ley Energy ends with Ley Power
